newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia to market HP cable modems.
newsitem.headline: Nokia to market HP cable modems.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said on Thursday it had agreed with Hewlett-Packard Co (HP) of the United States to market and distribute HP's QuickBurst cable modems as Nokia branded products in Europe.
"HP will supply Nokia with HP QuickBurst cable modems and link routers that will be marketed and distributed as Nokia branded products throughout Europe," Nokia said in a statement.
The agreement expands the product offer of Nokia's Multimedia Network Terminals Division to the cable market and will expand HP's direct sales channels in Europe, Nokia said.
"Nokia and HP estimate that the agreement will generate a significant amount of Internet related business for both companies over a multi-year period," it said.
The value of the agreement was not given.

"We have been watching the high speed data access arena carefully and teamed up with HP to enter into it because we see significant demand for high volumes," Nokia Multimedia Network Terminals President Heikki Koskinen said in the statement.
The two companies will also jointly explore future manufacturing and marketing concepts involving integrated video/data/voice gateways to end-users, the company said.
